name: Martial Arts Fighter Ryuu
source:
Arriving at the local dojo for your weekly martial arts training with Master Endou, you find his heir Ryuu waiting for you and not master Endou.
Apparently, Master Endou suddenly went on a trip and left your training in Ryuu’s hands.
Ryuu’s obviously not happy with that as he for some reason never was able to stand the sight of you. With now having to take charge of the dojo, he’s really irritated about also being forced to spend time with you.

Will you be able to prove to him that there’s more to you than he thinks?

[From the [url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/martial-arts-fighter-ryuu/] official website[/url]]
translation:
你来到当地道场，准备参加每周一次、由Endou师父指导的武术训练，却发现等着你的并非师父，而是他的继承人Ryuu。
原来，Endou师父突然出门旅行，把你的训练交给了Ryuu。
Ryuu显然很不高兴，不知为什么，他一向看你不顺眼。如今既要负责道场，又被迫花时间陪你，更让他烦躁不已。

你能向他证明，自己比他想象中更值得了解吗？

[摘自[url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/martial-arts-fighter-ryuu/]官方网站[/url]]
